class.description:
Name of the StorageClass to use when requesting storage provisioning.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/persistent-volumes/#storageclasses DEPRECATED

emptyDir.description:
EmptyDirVolumeSource to be used by the Prometheus StatefulSets. If specified, used in place of any volumeClaimTemplate.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#emptydir

selector.description: A label query over volumes to consider for binding. DEPRECATED

resources.description:
Resources represents the minimum resources the volume should have.
More info: http://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/persistent-volumes#resources DEPRECATED

volumeClaimTemplate.description: A PVC spec to be used by the Prometheus StatefulSets.

title:
StorageSpec defines the configured storage for a group Prometheus servers.
See documentation https://coreos.com/operators/prometheus/docs/latest/api.html#storagespec
name: K8sPrometheusStorageSpec
